# Laboratory Experiments

This directory contains all laboratory experiments for the project.

## Purpose

Experiments validate hypotheses and test proposed solutions before full implementation.

## Experiment Guidelines

1. Document hypothesis clearly
2. Define success criteria
3. Record methodology
4. Capture results objectively
5. Draw evidence-based conclusions

## Naming Convention

Experiments follow the pattern: `PROJECT-EXP-XXX.md`
